text: {"observations":"Four broadband noisy bursts of about 1 s each occur at roughly 0.4-1.3 s, 1.4-2.4 s, 2.5-3.3 s and 3.5-4.3 s, with the strongest energy below about 1 kHz and noise extending up to 7-8 kHz. After about 4.4 s only quiet tonal content remains, then a steady tonal sound (bands near 500 Hz, 1 kHz, 1.6 kHz) from 7.5 s. The repeated, harsh, low-frequency-heavy roar bouts fit a lion's roaring sequence better than a dog's bark or a wolf's tonal howl (no sustained harmonic glides during the bursts); a bear cannot be firmly excluded, so this is a best guess favouring A.","answer":"A"}
